name: dap
description: Debug C/C++ programs using GDB's or LLDB's built-in Debug Adapter Protocol support

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration

kdap.gdb.path.description: The path to the gdb binary. Defaults to searching for 'gdb' in PATH.

kdap.lldb.path.description: The path to the lldb-dap binary. Defaults to searching for 'lldb-dap', then 'lldb-dap-<version>', in PATH.

kdap.logPath.description: Enable DAP logging. Logs are written to this filename. If empty, logging is disabled.

kdap.gdb.logLevel.description: Set gdb's DAP logging level. The default is 1, which logs the DAP protocol and unexpected exceptions. Level 2 also logs exceptions that are considered expected, such as a failure to parse an expression.

kdap.environment.description: Extra environment variables to set on the debugger process.

kdap.gdb.qtPrettyPrinters.description: Automatically load Qt pretty-printers for gdb. If they haven't been downloaded yet, starting a debug session offers to download them.

debuggerPath.markdownDescription: The path to the gdb executable to use.

sysroot.description: Path to the system root gdb should use when looking for shared libraries and debug info, as if by 'set sysroot'. If empty or omitted, gdb's default sysroot handling applies.

skipInitFiles.description: Skip reading the debugger's own init files. For gdb, as if by passing '-nx'.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps source paths recorded in the debug info to their location on disk, as if by 'set substitute-path'. Each key is the path as recorded in the debug info and each value is where that path is found locally.

program.description: Path to the executable to debug. Corresponds to gdb's 'file' command.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the inferior, as if by 'set args'.

cwd.markdownDescription: The working directory for gdb and the launched program. If omitted, gdb inherits VS Code's working directory rather than the workspace folder, so set this explicitly (e.g. `${workspaceFolder}`).

env.description: Environment variables for the inferior. Each key is a variable name and each value must be a string. Setting this replaces the inferior's entire environment rather than adding to it, so PATH, HOME and friends must be listed too. If omitted, the inferior inherits gdb's environment.

stopAtBeginningOfMainSubprogram.description: Set a temporary breakpoint at the program's main procedure, as if by the 'start' command.

stopOnEntry.description: Set a temporary breakpoint at the program's first instruction, as if by the 'starti' command.

debuggerPath.markdownDescription: The path to the gdb executable to use.

sysroot.description: Path to the system root gdb should use when looking for shared libraries and debug info, as if by 'set sysroot'. If empty or omitted, gdb's default sysroot handling applies.

skipInitFiles.description: Skip reading the debugger's own init files. For gdb, as if by passing '-nx'.

sourceFileMap.description: Maps source paths recorded in the debug info to their location on disk, as if by 'set substitute-path'. Each key is the path as recorded in the debug info and each value is where that path is found locally.

pid.description: The process ID to which gdb should attach.

program.description: Path to the executable being debugged. In some cases gdb can determine this automatically, but for many remote targets it must be supplied.

target.description: The target to which gdb should connect, passed to the 'target remote' command.

coreFile.description: Path to a core dump file to load instead of attaching to a live process.
